answer: Post a $200 bounty on your own head. A newcomer locks $200 in escrow, publishes one profile tied to a single key, under a velvet rope rule: anyone who proves the identity fake, the work copied, or a review bought collects the full bounty. It stays open 90 days while the newcomer finishes 15 real jobs, each receipt client-signed and pinned to a public ridge. Proven fraud pays the whistleblower, burns the profile, and blocks the key 180 days. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $200,000 plus 15,000 signed jobs, about 3,750 hours. Like a plume of smoke over a campfire, one wisp and the camp sees it.
